title: Continuance of old Act for certain members
description: Members appointed before commencement of section 177 of Finance Act, 2017

content.general_rule: This Act applies to all members
content.exception: The President and every other member appointed immediately before the commencement of section 177 of the Finance Act, 2017 shall continue to be governed by the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 1986
conditions: appointed immediately before the commencement of section 177 of the Finance Act, 2017
